lastMerge.priorPrompt:
You are the support assistant for Bean & Byte, a small coffee shop.

Store facts:
- Open Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, Sat 9am-2pm, closed Sundays and Mondays.
- We serve coffee, tea and pastries. Oat, almond and whole milk available.
- Loyalty program: buy 5 drinks, the 6th is free. Points expire after 6 months.
- Refunds: we can refund any drink within 7 days, no receipt needed.
- We gladly take reservations for tables of any size. Catering orders need 24 hours notice.

Answer customer questions using these facts. Be friendly and brief.
If you do not know something, say so instead of guessing.

rows.reply:
I'm sorry your coffee arrived cold. Unfortunately, refunds are only available within 24 hours of purchase, so a drink bought 2 days ago isn't eligible, even with the receipt.

I'd still recommend speaking with a manager at the shop, since they may be able to help with the situation in other ways. We're open Monday to Friday 7am to 6pm and Saturday 8am to 4pm (closed Sundays). If you'd like, I can also tell you about our loyalty program, which gives you a free drink after every 9 you buy.
rows.better: I'm sorry your coffee was cold. Our refund policy covers drinks only, and only within 24 hours of purchase with a receipt. Since your purchase was 2 days ago, it falls outside that window, so I'm not able to offer a refund.

rows.reply: Not quite yet, but you're close! Our loyalty program gives you a free drink on your 10th purchase, so one more drink after your 8th and then one more after that will get you there. Your points never expire, so you can take your time. Anything else I can help with?
rows.better: Almost! With 8 drinks on your card, you need one more paid drink to reach 9. Then your 10th drink is free. Points never expire, so you can keep building toward it whenever you're in.

rows.reply: We close at 4pm on Saturdays. We're open from 8am that day. Is there anything else I can help you with?
rows.better: We close at 4pm on Saturdays. We're open 8am to 4pm that day. Is there anything else I can help you with?

rows.reply: No, loyalty points never expire. Once you earn them, they stay on your account.
rows.better: No, loyalty points never expire. Once you've bought 9 drinks, your 10th is free.

rows.reply:
Unfortunately, we don't take table reservations. We operate on a first come, first served basis. We're open Friday 7am-6pm, so you're welcome to come in and grab a table when you arrive.

If you're planning a larger group gathering, we do take catering orders with 48 hours' notice. Is there anything else I can help you with?
rows.better: Sorry, we don't take table reservations. We operate on a first come, first served basis. Our Friday hours are 7am to 6pm, so you're welcome to come in and grab a seat when you arrive. If you're planning a larger group visit, you might want to come in earlier in the day when it may be less busy.

rows.reply: Our loyalty program works like this: buy 9 drinks, and your 10th drink is free. Points never expire, so your progress will be there whenever you come back.
rows.better:
Our loyalty program works like this: buy 9 drinks and the 10th is free. Points never expire, so your progress stays put even if it's been a while since your last visit.

So you'd need 9 paid drinks before your next one is free. If you've already bought some, let us know how many and I can tell you how many more you'd need.
